title: Program Framework & Delivery Model
subtitle: Modular instructor-led technology training designed for college students and freshers

audience.mode: Online instructor-led sessions with demonstrations, guided labs, assignments and doubt-clearing
audience.learningApproach: Concepts → Demonstration → Hands-on Practice → Assignment → Project

breakdown.desc: Core theoretical foundations, architecture and syntax
Instructor-led walkthrough of working code and tools
Active student coding, guided exercises and debugging
Q&A, troubleshooting, daily recap and assignment briefing
In-depth concept explanation, patterns and industry context
Comprehensive live build and tool execution
Extended lab time for multi-step tasks and mini-projects
Live Q&A, code reviews, retrospective and homework setup

assessmentWeightage.evidence: Lab tasks, scripts, code or test artefacts
Project quality, functionality and technical decisions
Live demo, architecture explanation and Q&A defense

passingStandard: 70% overall, subject to successful completion of mandatory practical and project components.

certificationMapping.evidence: Attendance, knowledge check and mini exercise
Practical tasks and assessed mini project
Capstone, technical presentation and final assessment
